name: Plenum Manager
description: AI money manager for groups on Plenum. It may only buy and sell the assets a group approved, within the size, turnover and cooldown limits of the group's onchain mandate; bigger moves go to a member vote and any two members can pause it. It has no transfer tool and cannot withdraw. Every action commits a hash of its written reasoning and its model id onchain.

plenum.reputation: Feedback counts only from members of the group, each admitted by a member-signed invite (tag1 "plenum")
